import bpy,json
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['work15'];craft=ns['craft']
for o in craft.objects:
 if not o.get('work15_sheet'):continue
 me=o.data;uv=me.uv_layers.active
 for p in me.polygons:
  side=1 if sum(me.vertices[vi].co.x for vi in p.vertices)>=0 else -1
  for li in p.loop_indices:
   q=me.vertices[me.loops[li].vertex_index].co
   uv.data[li].uv=((.04 if side>0 else .54)+(q.y-3.25)/4.723*.40,.003+abs(q.x)/.761*.176)
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('W15 cap atlas assigned per roof face, with separate ridge UVs.')
